Adventures of Teaching

I had the pleasure of serving as a long-term sub for 7th grade science during the 25/26 school year, teaching Plate Tectonics, Geology, Chemistry, and Ecology. I learned so much about teaching — and about myself. Running labs, building assignments, going on field trips, and working with my students to find new ways to get them excited about science was more fun than I expected. Best of all was watching them build critical thinking skills and learn to use the scientific method — it felt like I was handing them tools they'll need in a world where that kind of thinking matters more every year.
